create_modular_optimizer: create a ModularPointCloudOptimizer instance to optimize a global scene with pairwise observations
preset_camera_poses: preset known camera poses in the ModularPointCloudOptimizer to freeze partial poses during optimization
preset_camera_intrinsics: preset known camera intrinsics including focal length and principal point for selected images
get_3d_points: get the 3D point cloud by converting depth maps to world frame coordinates using get_pts3d
get_camera_intrinsics: get the camera intrinsics matrix including focal lengths and principal points for all images
